arguments.content: The Congolian rainforest (Congo Basin rainforest) is the tropical rainforest that represents a quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth, and is the world's second-largest tropical rainforest (and one of the most biodiverse tropical forest tracts on the planet).
